svg.script: (function(){function S(D,L){var P=1,l=4294967295,a=0,R,m=new Uint8Array(L),o=0,n=function(r){return new Uint16Array(r).fill(1024)};for(R=0;R<4;R++)a=a*256+D[P++];function f(r,s){var t=r[s],i=(l>>>11)*t;return a<i?(l=i,r[s]=t+(2048-t>>5),t=0):(l-=i,a-=i,r[s]=t-(t>>5),t=1),l<16777216&&(l*=256,a=a*256+D[P++]),t}function E(r,s,t){for(var i=1,z=t;z--;)i=i*2+f(r,s+i);return i-(1<<t)}function K(r,s,t){for(var i=1,z=0,F,G=0;G<t;G++)F=f(r,s+i),i=i*2+F,z|=F<<G;return z}function W(r){for(var s=0,t;r--;)l=l>>>1,t=0,a>=l&&(a-=l,t=1),s=s*2+t,l<16777216&&(l*=256,a=a*256+D[P++]);return s}function N(r){return f(r,0)?f(r,1)?16+E(r,258,8):8+E(r,130,3):E(r,2,3)}for(var X=n(192),Y=n(12),Z=n(12),_=n(12),$=n(12),p=n(192),O=n(6144),ee=n(256),re=n(130),te=n(16),ie=n(514),ne=n(514),e=0,u=0,y=0,A=0,T=0,I=0,g,c,j,k,q,x,Q,b,M,w;o<L;)if(f(X,e<<4)){if(!f(Y,e))T=A,A=y,y=u,g=N(ie),e=e<7?7:10,Q=g<4?g:3,b=E(ee,Q*64,6),b<4?u=b:(M=(b>>1)-1,u=(2|b&1)<<M,b<14?u+=K(re,u-b-1,M):(w=W(M-4),u+=w*16+K(te,0,4)));else{if(f(Z,e))f(_,e)?(f($,e)?(w=T,T=A):w=A,A=y):w=y,y=u,u=w;else if(!f(p,e<<4)){e=e<7?9:11,I=m[o]=m[o-u-1],o++;continue}g=N(ne),e=e<7?8:11}for(g+=2;g--&&o<L;)m[o]=m[o-u-1],o++;I=m[o-1]}else{if(j=768*(I>>5),c=1,e>=7){k=m[o-u-1];do if(q=k>>7&1,k<<=1,x=f(O,j+(1+q<<8)+c),c=c*2+x,q!=x)break;while(c<256)}for(;c<256;)c=c*2+f(O,j+c);m[o++]=I=c&255,e=e<4?0:e<10?e-3:e-6}return m}var H=document.getElementById("d"),C=H.textContent.trim(),V="!#$%()*+,-./0123456789:;=?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ^_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~",J={},d,U=0,B,v,h=new Uint8Array(C.length/5*4);for(d=0;d<85;d++)J[V[d]]=d;for(d=0;d<C.length;d+=5){for(v=0,B=0;B<5;B++)v=v*85+J[C[d+B]];h[U++]=v>>>24,h[U++]=v>>>16&255,h[U++]=v>>>8&255,h[U++]=v&255}document.getElementById("site").srcdoc=new TextDecoder().decode(S(h,+H.getAttribute("data-m")))})();
